llm.summary: This is a straightforward ride-hailing guidance skill with no executable code, credential handling, persistence, or hidden high-impact behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request filesystem, network, shell, browser, account, API, or local data access beyond ordinary model guidance.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact consists of a single Markdown skill file; no scripts, dependencies, installers, remote payloads, or executable components were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to user-facing travel guidance, budgeting caveats, safety reminders, and directing disputes or current prices back to the app.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, profile/session access, memory writes, privilege escalation, or tool modification instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's purpose is to advise on CaoCao Mobility ride options, fare estimates, safety features, and enterprise travel management, and the artifact content stays within that informational scope.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: This skill appears safe to install as an informational guide. Users should still treat fare estimates, city coverage, service details, and phone numbers as advisory and verify current prices or availability in the official app before booking.
